questions.response: write the answer and show the required work
questions.prompt: AB is a diameter of circle O and C is any other point on the circle. Prove that ∠ACB is a right angle.
questions.prompt_markup: AB is a diameter of circle O and C is any other point on the circle. Prove that ∠ACB is a right angle.
questions.required_method: Use the inscribed angle theorem (the intercepted arc is 180°), or the two isosceles triangles AOC and BOC.
questions.grading_note: Any valid proof (paragraph, two-column, or flow). Essential (theorem): ∠ACB intercepts a semicircle, 180°, so it measures 90°. Alternative: OA = OC = OB, so △AOC and △BOC are isosceles; with base angles x and y, the angle sum of △ABC gives 2x + 2y = 180°, so x + y = 90° = m∠ACB.

questions.prompt: Compass and straightedge only; leave all arcs. Construct the two tangent lines from point P to circle O.
questions.prompt_markup:
Compass and straightedge only; leave all arcs.
Construct the two tangent lines from point P to circle O.
questions.correct_answer: Construct the midpoint M of OP; draw the circle with center M through O and P; it meets circle O at T₁ and T₂; lines PT₁ and PT₂ are tangents.
questions.grading_note: Grade the construction marks, not only the final figure: the perpendicular bisector of OP, the circle on diameter OP, and both tangent lines.
